slug: 被贬废丹房我偷偷无敌了
content_zh:
;;
玄黄大陆。
望仙宗。
执法殿外的天空之上，一轮血色残月从云层中偷偷钻了出来，给整个大殿镀上了一层暗红色。
“丹房弟子陈长生，因操作失误，炼制出有毒聚气丹，导致十二名弟子中毒，现废除你的修为，令你到废丹房工作……”
雄伟威严的大殿中，执法殿长老严冰不带一丝感情的冰冷声音传遍整个大殿。
话罢，不待陈长生分辩，严冰隔空一掌打在陈长生的丹田之上，“噗”的一声，陈长生惨叫一声，随即丹田就被击破，里面的灵气瞬间全部泄露出来。
陈长生跪伏在地，冷汗顿时顺着额头流了下来，心中充满了绝望。
丹田碎裂，从此再无仙缘。
而且废丹房是什么地方，都是丹毒，没有修为的他估计活不过一个月就要被毒死。
陈长生原本是丹房一名丹童，几日前协助常隆师兄炼制一炉聚气丹，谁知道居然炼制了一炉有毒的聚气丹出来，结果导致十二名弟子服用后中毒。
回想当日，炼丹的时候自己肚子疼去了趟茅房，结果就出事了，肯定是有人趁着这段时间捣的鬼。
毕竟明明自己所有的药材都没有弄错，哪里来的毒性。
自己是为常隆顶了锅，而那常隆从始至终居然一句求情的话也没有为自己说，当真是人心冷漠。
“你还不谢恩？”
见陈长生坐在那里不动，严冰那不耐烦的声音再次传了出来。
“原本应该把你逐出宗门，然上天有好生之德，让你去废丹房已经是宗门的恩惠了。”
“是啊，我等已经是仁至义尽。”
“去吧，好死不如赖活着。”
“你现在没有修为，在废丹房苟活一世吧！”

大殿上那些掌权者一个个很不耐烦，赶苍蝇一般，甚至有些人语气中还有点幸灾乐祸的意味。
这些话落在陈长生的耳中，犹如根根钢刺插在他的心上。
“弟子……遵命！”
陈长生咬了咬牙从地上爬了起来，他打算暂时去废丹房，当务之急是要先活下来。
玄黄大陆危险无比，外面到处都是危机，以他现在的状况出去估计活不过三天。
况且，家族费尽心机牺牲了唯一一个名额才让他进入望仙宗，就这样回去其他族人怎么看？
陈长生默默转身，背影说不出的萧瑟。
刚刚走出大殿，就看见一道美丽倩影，她一身白色衣裙，傲立于银色月华之下，肌肤胜雪，清冷孤傲。
青丝如墨瀑垂落，衬得那张毫无瑕疵的脸庞愈发清丽绝伦。
这是他的未婚妻顾清影。
顿时四目相对，只不过今天的那双清冷双眸似是没有了往日的温度。
“清影，你……都知道了？”
陈长生指节捏得发白，偷偷看了顾清影一眼，语气有些干涩。
顾清影天资聪慧，水系极品灵根，资质逆天，被某个长老破例收为亲传弟子。
原本自己和她虽然有差距，但也不是没有希望。
现在的话，两人之间隔着一道不可逾越的鸿沟。
这道鸿沟犹如天堑一般。
顾清影如水的眸子只是从陈长生苍白的脸庞上匆匆掠过，没有丝毫留恋和同情。
content_en:
;;
Xuanhuang Continent.
Wangxian Sect.
In the sky outside the Law Enforcement Hall, a bloody waning moon sneaked out from the clouds, coating the entire hall with a layer of dark red.
"Chen Changsheng, a disciple of the Alchemy Room, made a poisonous Qi Gathering Pill due to operational errors, which caused the poisoning of twelve disciples. Your cultivation is hereby abolished and you are ordered to work in the Abandoned Alchemy Room..."
In the majestic and majestic hall, the cold and emotionless voice of Yan Bing, the elder of the Law Enforcement Hall, spread throughout the hall.
After saying this, without waiting for Chen Changsheng to argue, Yan Bing hit Chen Changsheng's dantian with a palm from the air. With a "pop", Chen Changsheng screamed, and then his dantian was broken, and all the spiritual energy inside was leaked out instantly.
Chen Changsheng knelt on the ground, cold sweat suddenly flowing down his forehead, and his heart was filled with despair.
The Dantian was shattered, and there was no chance of immortality ever again.
Moreover, wherever the Waste Pill Room is, it is full of erysipelas. Without cultivation, he would probably be poisoned to death within a month.
Chen Changsheng was originally an alchemy boy in the alchemy room. A few days ago, he assisted Senior Brother Chang Long in refining a furnace of Qi Gathering Pills. Who knew that he actually refined a furnace of poisonous Qi Gathering Pills? As a result, twelve disciples were poisoned after taking them.
Thinking back to that day, when I was refining alchemy, I had a stomachache and went to the hut, but something happened. Someone must have taken advantage of this time to cause trouble.
After all, all the medicinal materials he used were correct, so where did the toxicity come from.
He took the blame for Chang Long, but Chang Long didn't say a word of mercy for himself from beginning to end. He was really indifferent.
"Aren't you still grateful?"
Seeing Chen Changsheng sitting there motionless, Yan Bing's impatient voice came out again.
"Originally, you should have been expelled from the sect, but God is so kind that it is already a favor from the sect to let you go to the Elimination Pill Room."
"Yes, we have done our best to be benevolent and righteous."
"Go ahead, it's better to die than live."
"You have no cultivation now, so you can survive in the useless alchemy room for the rest of your life!"
Those in power in the main hall were all very impatient, as if they were chasing away flies, and some even sounded a little gloating in their tone.
These words fell in Chen Changsheng's ears, like steel thorns piercing his heart.
"Disciple...obey!"
Chen Changsheng gritted his teeth and got up from the ground. He planned to go to the Elimination Pill Room for the time being. The first priority was to survive.
The Xuanhuang Continent is extremely dangerous, and there are dangers everywhere outside. In his current condition, he probably wouldn't survive more than three days.
Moreover, the family had gone to great lengths to sacrifice the only spot available to allow him to enter the Wangxian Sect. What would other clan members think of him returning like this?
Chen Changsheng turned around silently, his back looking indescribably desolate.
As soon as she walked out of the hall, she saw a beautiful figure. She was wearing a white dress, standing proudly under the silver moonlight, her skin was better than snow, she was cold and aloof.
The black hair fell down like a waterfall of ink, making the flawless face even more beautiful.
This is his fiancée Gu Qingying.
Their eyes immediately met, but today's cold eyes seemed to lack the warmth of the past.
"Qingying, you...know everything?"
Chen Changsheng's knuckles turned white when he pinched them. He glanced at Gu Qingying secretly and his tone was dry.
Gu Qingying was gifted with intelligence, top-grade water spiritual roots, and unparalleled aptitudes, so he was accepted as a direct disciple by a certain elder.
Although there was a gap between him and her, there was still hope.
Now, there is an insurmountable gap between the two.
This gap is like a natural chasm.
Gu Qing's watery eyes just glanced over Chen Changsheng's pale face without any nostalgia or sympathy.
